name: loaded_stance_droop_map_v1
description: Whole-body LOADED DROOP MAP: quasi-static trajectory ramp into the steps_loaded_v1 plant stance (all six legs yaw 0 / hip 20 / knee 80), a flat 20 s hold there, and a mirror ramp back to bench zero. Purpose: the first PER-JOINT droop vector for all 18 joints in a loaded stance. The L0 hip is known to droop 3.4-3.8 deg under body load; the other 17 joints have never been measured loaded, and that 18-vector is exactly the feedforward offset a smooth gait needs. DELIVERABLE: commanded-vs-actual position on all 18 joints at the plateau -- the runner logs cmd{j}_deg and q{j}_deg every tick, so the droop vector is q - cmd averaged over the plateau, whose command is a clean uniform 0/20/80 on every leg with no per-leg offsets to subtract. PLATEAU IS TICKS 150-349 (t = 15.0-34.9 s) inclusive. ENTRY: this is entered as a trajectory replay, the same droop-tolerant mechanism champion_stand_ground_v1 and tripod_weight_shift_static_v2 use on the ground -- NO home_deg, so start_pose() is the leading traj's first row = bench zero, the runner's automatic start-pose glide sees travel <= GLIDE_TOL_DEG (3 deg, a hardcoded sysid_runner constant, not a protocol field) and is skipped entirely. That matters because the last two whole-body runs died in that glide's post-move per-joint verification: a 3.4 deg loaded hip droop at the stand pose can never verify within 3 deg, so the run aborted before the first tick and the gate was in effect reporting the very droop this protocol is built to measure. There is NO per-joint gate here: the plant stance is reached by the trajectory itself under motion, not snapped to and verified. The segment start_tol_deg of 12 deg is the mid-protocol traj continuity gate and is inert on segment 0. MOTION: single 500-tick / 50.0 s absolute traj at 10 Hz -- 150 ticks (15.0 s) LINEAR ramp from bench zero to the plant stance, 200 ticks (20.0 s) holding that command exactly constant, 150 ticks (15.0 s) linear ramp back, ending on bench zero. Yaw is identically 0.0 on all six legs for all 500 ticks: no yaw motion, no foot lift, no body translation, all six feet planted throughout. Peak joint rate is the knee at 80 deg / 15 s = 5.33 deg/s (hip 1.33 deg/s), under the runner's own 12 deg/s glide rate and well under the 220 counts/s (~19 deg/s) write profile, so the stand-up is quasi-static. LIMITS: soft torque 700; loaded current budget 2.0 A tripping after three consecutive readings above it; hard ceiling 3.0 A. Robot ON THE GROUND (unsupported), operator watching, hands ready; requires force=true, and --capture-vision (a runner CLI flag, not a protocol field) for the vision capture and camera admission.
